description: This file contains utility functions for formatting, sanitizing, and extracting text from message objects, including handling of special characters, RTL scripts, and binary data. It also includes functions for message content extraction, error formatting, and token usage display.

methods.name: hasControlChars
methods.description: Checks if the input text contains ASCII or C1 control characters.

methods.name: stripControlChars
methods.description: Removes control characters from the input text.

methods.name: chunkToken
methods.description: Splits a token into chunks of specified maximum length.

methods.name: isCopySensitiveToken
methods.description: Determines if a token is copy-sensitive, such as URLs, file paths, or long credential-like strings.

methods.name: normalizeLongTokenForDisplay
methods.description: Normalizes long tokens for display, preserving copy-sensitive tokens.

methods.name: redactBinaryLikeLine
methods.description: Redacts lines with many replacement characters, indicating binary data.

methods.name: isolateRtlLine
methods.description: Wraps RTL script lines with isolate characters for proper display.

methods.name: applyRtlIsolation
methods.description: Applies RTL isolation to multi-line text.

methods.name: sanitizeRenderableText
methods.description: Sanitizes text for rendering by removing ANSI, control characters, long tokens, and applying RTL isolation.

methods.name: resolveFinalAssistantText
methods.description: Determines the final assistant message text from final, streamed, or error messages.

methods.name: composeThinkingAndContent
methods.description: Combines thinking and content texts into a formatted string.

methods.name: asMessageRecord
methods.description: Converts an unknown message object to a record if possible.

methods.name: resolveMessageRecord
methods.description: Resolves a message object into its record and content parts.

methods.name: formatAssistantErrorFromRecord
methods.description: Formats an error message from a message record if stopReason is 'error'.

methods.name: collectSanitizedBlockStrings
methods.description: Collects and sanitizes text blocks of a specific type from message content.

methods.name: extractThinkingFromMessage
methods.description: Extracts only thinking blocks from a message.

methods.name: extractContentFromMessage
methods.description: Extracts only text content blocks from a message, excluding thinking blocks.

methods.name: extractTextBlocks
methods.description: Extracts and combines text and optionally thinking blocks from content.

methods.name: extractTextFromMessage
methods.description: Extracts sanitized text from a message, handling user role and errors.

methods.name: isCommandMessage
methods.description: Checks if a message is a command message.

methods.name: formatTokens
methods.description: Formats token count and context usage as a string.

methods.name: formatContextUsageLine
methods.description: Formats detailed token usage and remaining tokens info.

methods.name: asString
methods.description: Converts a value to string with fallback.
